dossier:
Company: DataBridge Solutions s.r.o., Brno, Czech Republic. Founded 2019, 140 employees. Offering: nearshore Java development and 24/7 application support for our policy administration system. Planned contract volume CHF 1.8 m per year, access to production data including policyholder records.

Financials (2025 annual report): revenue EUR 11.2 m (+38%), EBIT margin 4%, equity ratio 12%, a EUR 3 m credit line drawn to 90%. Largest customer accounts for 46% of revenue. Auditor's note mentions going-concern uncertainty if the credit line is not renewed in Q1 2027.

Information security: ISO 27001 certificate issued 2023, expired August 2026, recertification audit 'scheduled'. Last external pen test 2024 with two high findings, remediation status unknown. Developers work from home on personal laptops 'with VPN'. No SOC 2 report.

ESG: Signed the UN Global Compact 2024. Publishes no emissions data. Glassdoor rating 3.1, several reviews mention unpaid overtime. Subcontracts 30% of staff from a freelancer platform.

Legal and compliance: No sanctions or PEP hits for the company or its directors. One pending labour court case (wrongful dismissal). GDPR fine of EUR 25,000 in 2025 by the Czech DPA for a misdirected e-mail containing customer data. Willing to sign our DPA and standard contractual clauses.
